tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bla ma drag po'i las byang dngos grub kun 'byung zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// gzugs kyi zhud dang drags sngags bsgrags pa'i gzis// khams gsum dbang sdud srid gsum zil gnon cing*// dregs pa las 'khor khro bo 'dus pa'i lha// bla ma drag por phyag byas las byang bri// mngon par bsngags pa'i gnas su yo byad tshang bas bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste/ na mo bla ma bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku// dkon mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin la// bdag dang 'gro drug sems can rnams// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// sems bskyed pas ni gzhan don phyir// bla ma sangs rgyas 'grub gyur nas// gang la gang 'dul phrin las kyis// 'gro drug bsgral bar dam bca' 'o/ zhes lan gsum brjod nas/ bgegs la gtor ma gtor ba/ yakṣa me dbal du mos la/ hūṃ nga ni yakṣa me dbal te// padma dbang gi pho nya ba// bar chad byed pa'i bgegs thams cad// rgya mtsho'i mtha' la skrod par 'ongs// su zhig nga yi tshig 'da' ba// de yi lus sems rdul du rlog /de 'dra'i nyen la ma sdo bar// 'dod pa'i mchod sbyin 'di khyer las// khor yug ri bo'i skyobs la bros// oṃ āḥhūṃ yakṣa raksha hūṃ/ zhes bskrad/ mtshams bcad pa ni/ hūṃ chos kun ye dag ye rdzogs la// bdud dang log 'dren gdon bgegs ci// glo bur rkyen gyis ci bzos kyang*// ka dag dbyings las ga yos pa med// oṃ āḥhūṃ rakṣa rakṣa hūṃ/ snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros slob dpon padma dbang gi lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ hūṃ mchog gsum 'dus par phyag 'tshal myur po'i rlangs// kun bzang mchod sprin cher chags sdig bshags pa'i// char rgyun la 'thungs yid mtshor chos kyi klung*// 'bebs phyir srid par bzhugs zhes khyod la smon// lha tshogs de dag rang gi spyi bor thim// lus ni 'od zhu hūṃ dmar 'od 'phro ba// yas mtha' sangs rgyas mas mtha' dmyal ba'i bar// kun la 'phog pas mchod sbyangs de rnams zhu// byin rlabs nus pa rnam shes dbang bsdus shing*// slar yang 'od dmar mtshon cha'i dbyibs tsha bas// sde brgyad nyal nyal gtubs shing gzhob tu bsregs// mthu rtsal stobs rnams bdag la thim pa yis// srid gsum zil gnon dregs pa las la 'khol// hūṃ

hūṃ yig de las e yaṃ raṃ ra suṃ// keṃ dang bhrūṃ rnams rim bzhin chad pa las// e las chos 'byung gru gsum 'bar ba'i dbus// yaṃ las 'thor byed rlung gi zla gam steng*// raṃ las me dkyil dmar nag gru gsum 'bar// ra las khrag gi rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrug /suṃ las dur khrod sa gzhi 'jigs su rung*// keṃ las keṃ rus ri rab gru bzhi'i steng*// bhrūṃ las dur khrod 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang*// thod pa skam rlon bam ril brtsigs pa'i mkhar// gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dag dang ldan// zhing chen ka ba mchog gi dral bkrab nas// lha chen tshangs pa pho mo gdung mar bres// sha chen nag leb zhing lpags bla rer bres// thabs dang shes rab nyi zla'i skar khung bton// zur bzhi'i steng na zhing 'phan 'bar ba phyar// nang du gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu'i dbus// nyi zla dregs pa pho mo'i gdan kha na// hūṃ yig 'od zhu padma thod 'phreng rtsal// sku mdog dmar po dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar// zhal gcig phyag gnyis rngam rjid khro bo'i sku// phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu las// hūṃ dgu raṃ dgu bskal pa'i me 'bar ba// steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun tu rab gsor bas// gdul dka' dregs pa'i tshogs rnams rdul du rlog /phyag g.yon lcags kyi sdig pa mgo dgu pa// me dpung 'tshub cing zhal gdangs spyan dmar 'khrug /rgyal 'gong srog bdag dam sri pho mo yi// snying khrag 'jib cing snying za rtsad nas gcod// skye dang 'chi ba bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i phyir// zhal gdangs mche gtsigs drag po'i rkan sgra sgrog /spyan gsum dmar zlum sdang mig phyogs bcur gzigs// sreg byed me stag 'od kyi tsha tsha 'phro// gang dag nyams pa'i gzugs phung thams cad sreg /dbu skra gyen brdzes thod skam lnga yis brgyan// glang chen stod g.yogs stag gis sku smad klubs// mi mgo'i do shal sbrul chen brgyad kyis dkris// zhing chen rked bsnams khrag zhag thal chen brgyan// rus pa'i rgyan lnga rin chen rgyan chas brgyan// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum dregs pa pho mo brdzis// gzi brjid chen pos dregs pa thams cad gzir// steng rtsibs hūṃ mdzad shar nas g.yas skor du// rnam rgyal dbyug sngon gshin rje mi g.yo ba// rta mgrin gzhan gyis mi thub bdud rtsi dang*// khams gsum rnal rgyal 'og tu stobs po che// kun kyang mthing nag tho ba lcags kyu bsnams// dur khrod chas brgyan brkyang bskum gdon rnams brdzis// rang 'dra'i sprul pa 'gyed cing me dbus bzhugs// 'khor yug dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang*// sprul pa'i ging chen lha srin sde brgyad rnams// khro gtum 'jigs pa sna tshogs gzugs 'chang ba// gtso bo'i dpral bar 'khor lor gshin rje gshed// phyag g.yas shes rab ral gri klad la skor// mgrin par pad 'dab bzhi la rta mgrin dmar// phyag g.yas rdo rje'i dbyug tho nam mkhar 'phyar// thugs kar gser gyi mchod rten bum nang du// dregs pa phyag rdor phyag g.yas rdo rje 'phyar// kun kyang g.yon pa thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad// gsang gnas yaksha me dbal smug nag ni// tho ba 'phyar zhing me zhags thugs khar 'dzin// de thugs gnam lcags sdig snang bzhi ka yang*// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum dpal gyi chas kyis brgyan// lte bar chos 'byung padma ro gdan la// rdo rje phag mo gri thod kha ṭwāṃ bsnams// gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang thod pa'i 'phreng*// mgo bo'i do shal rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gros bskor// gtsug na bya khyung mthing nag me gshog can// gnam lcags mchu sder klu bdud zas su za// rigs bzhi'i khyung nas grangs med sprul pa 'gyed// de'i spyir nyi zla'i gdan la thod 'phreng rtsal// rigs lnga sku la rin chen rus pas brgyan// za 'og smug ber sha ba'i snyan zhu gsol// rgod kyi rtse rgyal dar gyi cod pan 'phur// thod dbyug mchan bcug skyil krung 'gying bag can// 'dzum zhal yum rnams gri thod bsnams nas 'khyud// gcer bu rus rgyan mnyam sbyor bde ba'i nyams// khor yug bla ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs thams cad// glu len gar byed bro rdung mdzad pas bskor//

de nas rol mo dbyangs snyan gyis/ hūṃ dur khrod me ri 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas// dregs pa 'dul mdzad padma thod 'phreng sku// bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs// 'gro ba sems can don la sku bzhengs 'tshal// 'dod chags khrag gi rgya mtsho klongs nas bzhengs// zhe sdang keng rus 'khrol ba'i dbus nas bzhengs// gti mug sha chen spungs pa'i dkyil nas bzhengs// 'bar ba rlung dud 'tshub pa'i khrod nas bzhengs// drag po'i las la gnas 'dir spyan 'dren na// dgra bgegs 'byung po 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol// dregs pa bco brgyad 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol// bar chad cho 'phrul zlog phyir gshegs su gsol/ zhes padma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas spyan drangs/ hūṃ nyi zla padma brtsegs pa'i gdan steng su// dam sri pho mo bsnol ba'i khri steng su// 'jigs byed che mchog padma 'byung gnas sku// 'khor dang bcas pa brtan par bzhugs su gsol// hūṃ rang byung lhun grub padma 'byung gnas sku// dus gsum sangs rgyas sku gsung thugs las sprul// lha srin drag po 'dul ba'i las mdzad pa// 'khor dang bcas la dad pas phyag 'tshal lo// hūṃ rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi// byang chub sgrub la bar du gcod byed pa'i// gzugs can dgra dang gzugs med bgegs thams cad// bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus pa mchod par 'bul// dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig ye shes gnyis su med par gyur// kyai dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// 'od gsal lhun grub skye 'gro yongs kyi mgon// mya ngan mi 'da' rdo rje lta bu'i sku// mnyam pa med pa'i che mchog he ru ka /'gro mgon bla ma mchog la skyabs su mchi// bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs tu gsol// sku mchog 'gyur med buddha thod 'phreng rtsal// gsung mchog 'gag med padma thod 'phreng rtsal// thugs mchog sgrib med badzra thod 'phreng rtsal// yon tan kun rdzogs ratna thod 'phreng rtsal// 'phrin las thogs med karma thod 'phreng rtsal// gsang mtshan lnga dang ldan la phyag 'tshal bstod// bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// kyai

gu ru rigs lnga mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kyis// rjes 'jug dad mos rnal 'byor bdag cag gi /lus la brtul bzhugs gzi brjid bskyed du gsol// ngag la nus pa'i byin rlabs sbar du gsol// sems la rtogs pa'i ye shes bskyed du gsol// lus ngag yid gsum smin par mdzad du gsol// buddha gu ru ā yu ṣe oṃ/ badzra gu ru ā yu ṣe hūṃ/ ratna gu ru ā yu ṣe trāṃ/ padma gu ru ā yo ṣe hrīḥ/ karma gu ru ā yu ṣe āḥ/ thod 'phreng rigs lnga'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang*// sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang mchod nas su// dgyes pas zhu ba'i bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas// so so'i sbyi bor thim nas dga' bde rgyas// dga' bde rgyas pa'i mod la rig 'dzin lha// yab yum sbyor ba mdzad pa'i sbyor mtshams nas// byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi babs pa yis// bdag rgyan spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo gang*// lus kyi dri dag sku yi dam tshig skongs// bum pa'i dbang bskur yongs su rdzogs pa thob/ de nas mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo gang*// ngag gi dri dag gsung gi dam tshig skongs// gsang ba'i dbang bskur yongs su rdzogs pa thob// de nas snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo gang*// sems kyi dri dag thugs kyi dam tshig skongs// shes rab ye shes dbang bskur yongs rdzogs thob// de nas lte ba sprul sku 'khor lo gang*// sgo gsum dri dag sku gsum dam tshig skongs// tshig gi dbang bskur yongs su rdzogs pa thob// rang lus rtsa gsum 'khor lo rnam pa lnga// byang chub sems kyis rab tu gang ba'i rgyan// khyung spyir snang mtha' sprul sku'i chas kyis bzhugs// oṃ āḥhūṃ buddha mahā gu ru sarba siddhi hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ badzra mahā gu ru sarba siddhi hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ratna mahā gu ru sarba siddhi hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ padma mahā gu ru sarba siddhi hūṃ/

oṃ āḥhūṃ karma ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūṃ/ zhes sgom zhing dngos grub dbang gi snying po ci rigs bzlas so/ /de nas rigs lnga gnas lnga'i khro bor thim// 'khor rnams bdag gi lus dang gnyis med gyur/ /yang yang gsal btab cing bsgom mo// de nas mchod rdzas rnams bsangs la byin gyis brlab pa ni/ /oṃ mchod rdzas kun gyi ma dag dri ma sbyangs// āḥmi mdzad nam mkha'i mchod du rnam par spel// hūṃ kun bzang mchod sprin ji ltar dgyes der spar// hoḥphyi nang gsang ba bla med bdud rtsir zhu/ /de nas phyi mchod 'bul ba/ hūṃ srid pa'i rnam 'phrul la bgad me tog gi /tshems 'phreng 'od kyis nam mkha'i khyon 'gengs shing*// yongs 'du 'khri shing spos sprin gzugs gser gyis// bar snang ma lus dri bzang gter du sbas// des skyo nyin mor byed pa'i snang byed bzang*// dkyil 'khor las 'phos sa yi mar mer 'khril// des kun bsreg dogs byug pa'i tshad chen nas// lbu dkar shal can dzahtu'i bu mo byon// kha dog ro bcud bsil ba'i zer tshang ma// ting 'dzin kham zas rgyu skar khrid pa'ang chas// de dag dog gseb lha rdzas rol po'i sprin// 'brug sgra'i gar gyi ngang tshul la chags dang*// sa la dom 'os mthu ldan rin chen bdun// gnam la rab grags bkra shis rdzas kun dang*// rgya mtshor 'phyur ba'i klu dbang gdeng ka'i rgyan// ma lus dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha la 'bul// oṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa swā hā/ nang mchod 'bul/ hūṃ lha mi'i tshogs grwar yid 'ong mdzes ma'i gzugs// snyan dang 'jebs pa'i pha mtha' de glu'i sgra// gsung zhim ngad pa'i snying po lus kyi dri// myangs kyin ngoms med ma mchu sbrang gi ro// bde ba'i phul phyin bha ga'i reg bya dang*// mig la bdud rtsi sgeg sogs lha mo'i 'gying*// bsam pa'i yul min kun bzang spyod pa'i gar// bla ma drag po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/

oṃ mahā su kha pū dza ho/ gsang mchod sman 'bul ba/ hūṃ rtsa brgyad yan lag stong la sgrubs pa'i rdzas// dza gad la sgyangs kha dog 'ja' ltar bkra// dri bsung yongs 'du ljon pa zhu ba bzhin// ro bcud ting 'dzin las 'dra mchod par 'bul// oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā h-i/ rakta/ hūṃ padma'i snod ni chos dbyings nam mkha'i khyon// bha ga'i rakta gzung ba stong pa'i bcud// 'byung ba'i rtsi khrag 'dzin pa rig pa'i dpyid// bsgral ba'i dmar chen zung 'jug chen pos mchod// mahā rakta khā hi/ gtor ma/ hūṃ brtan pa'i 'jig rten shes rab gtor snod gzhong*// g.yo ba'i sems can thabs mkhas gtor ma'i rdzas// thabs shes gnyis med gtor chen skyon bral ba// zag med bdud rtsi dam par bzhu nas 'bul// snying po'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūṃ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūṃ hūṃ a hūṃ hūṃ phaṭḥphaṭ/ ya manta ka/ ha ya gṛ wa/ badzra pā ṇi/ ḍā ki nī/ ka ru ṇa hūṃ phaṭḥ.oṃ badzra yaksha hūṃ phaṭḥ/ i daṃ bha lingta khā hi khā hi/ dgra bgegs thams cad kyi gti mug sha la khā hi/ zhes sdang rus la khā hi/ 'dod chags khrag la khā hi/ dbang po lnga la khā hi/ don snying lnga la khā hi/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa 'bul ba/ hūṃ lta ba'i dgra bgegs 'byung po kun bsgral nas// gang shar ka dag dbyings su sbyor ba yi// mchod pa'i mchog 'di thog mtha' bar med cing*// bdag med gzhan bral mnyam nyid chen por mchod// de nas bstod pa ni/ hūṃ chos kyi dbyings nas sku skyod tshe// bdud mun rlag byed dmar ba'i 'od// tsha zer bdun 'gyur shar snyam nas// srid gsum 'dar bar mdzad la bstod// hūṃ shin tu khros shing rab khros zhal// mi bzad mche gtsigs ljags bsgril rtser// drag po'i sngags rgod kun bsgrags pas// dgra bgegs gsod par mdzad la bstod// hūṃ spyan gsum gzir ba'i lta stangs dang*// sma ra smin ma ral pa dang*// ba spu khung nas 'bar ba'i mes// bar chad bgegs 'dul mdzad la bstod// hūṃ

rdo rje bcangs pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis// ri rab kun kyang 'jig byed dang*// rgya mtsho yongs kyi lto brtol bas// dregs pa spa bkong mdzad la bstod// hūṃ khams gsum thams cad shar mthong za// srid gsum khrag kun hub gcig gis// 'thung 'dod sdig pa mgo dgu pas// log 'dren rlag par mdzad la bstod// hūṃ ba glang zhing dang stag lpags bgos// thod 'phreng mgo bo'i ga sha dang*// phyag rgya sbrul dang khrag zhag thal// rin chen rgyan 'dzin mdzad la bstod// hūṃ drag shul chen po'i gzugs kyi phyin// mthong na phal cher khrag skyug pa// 'jigs su rung sogs gar nyams kyis// 'jig rten 'jig par mdzad la bstod// hūṃ g.yon brkyang zhabs kyis dregs pa'i sde// pho brgyud mo brgyud kun mnan nas// pad nyi'i gdan la me dpung nang*// mngon par rol par mdzad la bstod// hūṃ bde gshegs kun gyi 'dus pa khyod// yin pa shes phyir rgyan gyi lha// 'jam dpal rta mgrin phyag rdor dang*// phag mo me dbal bstan la bstod// hūṃ steng gi lha dang 'og gi klu// bar gyi gdug pa kun gyi gshed// khyung nag nyid dang dbang dgug lha// rigs bdag rngom brjid mdzad la bstod// hūṃ phyogs bcu 'jig rten gdon gzir bar// nyid sprul khro bo'i rgyal po bcu// mkha' 'gro chos skyong ging gi tshogs// kun nas skor bar mdzad la bstod//

de nas man ngag bzhin dregs pa'i snying gar nyi ma la hūṃ gi mtha' mar/ oṃ āḥhūṃ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūṃ hūṃ a hūṃ hūṃ phaṭḥphaṭḥ/ ya manta ka/ ha ya grī wa/ badzra pā ṇi/ ḍā ki ni/ ka ru ṇa hūṃ phaṭḥ/ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭḥ/ oṃ badzra yaksha hūṃ phaṭḥ/ gnod byed sarba mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭḥ/ mgal me 'khor ba lta bu las yaksha me dbal nam mkha' gang bar spros/ gnod byed thams cad gsad gcad gtubs/ bdag dang rgyan gyi lha thams cad las 'phros pa'i me dpung gis bdag gi sdig sgrib bsregs/ lus ngag yid bde bar ldan pa dang*/ ras de'i mi dang gser gyi 'khor lo rtse bsnol ba'i bar du/ dgra bgegs kyi skye phrul lu lu gcod par bsam la bzlas so/ mthar me long la has btab pa ltar bsdus nas stong pa nyid la gzhug /yang de las skad cig gis lhar langs te spyod lam dang bya ba la 'jug go /dge ba'i rtsa ba spyi mthun bsngo'o/ stod las so/ de nas tshogs bshams te bsangs nas/ hūṃ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gsum yig 'bru'i 'phro 'du las// nyes skyon bsregs gtor sbyangs pas dag par gyur// yaṃ raṃ keṃ a 'phro 'dus rlung me thod// oṃ āḥhūṃ gis sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga// oṃ āḥhūṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ hrīḥthāḥ/ rlung gis me sbar thod dros bdud rtsir zhu// de rlangs zla phyed rdo rje hūṃ mtshan gyur// de las 'od 'phros ye shes bdud rtsi bstim// de nyid 'od zhu gnyis su med par gyur// spos dang rnga sil dbyangs kyis/ hūṃ nub phyogs u rgyan sprul pa'i dur khrod nas// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro sprin bzhin 'dus pa'i dbus// chags bral pad nyi ro yi gdan steng na// rngam brjid stobs ldan padma thod 'phreng sku// dus ngan snyigs ma'i 'gro ba 'thul ba dang*// bdag cag rjes 'jug thugs rjes gzung slad du// zhal zas 'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren na// thugs rjes rdzu 'phrul ldan pas skyod par 'tshal// byin rlabs dngos grub 'bebs phyir gshegs su gsol// yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad dang*// dam can chos skyong bka' nyan ging ka ra// lha srin yongs kyis bskor nas 'dir byon cig

/hūṃ tshogs khang dur khrod 'bar ba'i gzhal yas 'dir// padma zla nyi baṃ chen brtsegs pa'i khar// rngam brjid dgyes pa'i gar gyis bzhugs nas kyang*// tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlab tu gsol// tshogs phud dang po/ hūṃ rig 'dzin bla ma drag po'i lha tshogs dang*// yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong ging tshogs la// 'dod yon lnga ldan tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul// thugs rjes bzhes la dbang dang dngos grub stsol// bar ma/ hūṃ bdag ni thog med dus nas da lta'i bar// nyon mongs 'khrul pa'i dbang gyur sgo gsum gyis// mi dge spyod pas rgyal ba'i dgongs 'gal ba// tshogs mchod 'dir rten gnong zhing 'gyod pas bshags/ thugs rjes brtse bas tshangs pa yar bzhes la// ye shes don gyi dag pa bdag la stsol// sa mā ya a la la/ hūṃ bskang ba med de khams gsum yongs kyis bskang*// sgrol ba med de khams gsum yongs kyis sgrol// sbyor ba med de khams gsum yongs kyis sbyor// ye sgrol ye sbyor chen pos thugs dam bskangs// ho/ bka' drin 'khor ba med pa'i rdo rje'i slob dpon chen po/ rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa/ byin rlabs mkha' 'gro'i brgyud pa/ rigs 'dzin brda'i brgyud pa/ gang zag snyan khung brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad la gser skyems phud kyi mchod pa 'bul lo// 'khor lo/ rdo rje/ rin chen/ padma/ las kyi rigs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba zhi ba dang*/ chags pa dang*/ khro bo'i rnam par snang ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad la gser skyems phud kyi mchod pa 'bul lo// gsang sngags dang*/ rig sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ gzung sngags dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo thams cad la gser skyems phud kyi mchod pa 'bul lo// sems dpa' dang sems ma dang*// khro bo dang*/ khro mo/ dkyil 'khor chen por 'du ba'i dge 'dun thams cad la gser skyems phud kyi mchod pa 'bul lo// dpal rdo rje srin po/

mahā kā la lcam dral/ rnal 'byor gyi dgra lha/ dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu/ dregs pa bco brgyad/ phyi nang gsang ba sbas pa drag po sngags las byed btags chags kyi lha ma srin sde brgyad/ btsun mo nang mi mngag gzhug gnag gi gnyan dmag gi tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad la gser skyems phud kyi mchod 'bul lo// khyad par du yul 'di skyong ba rnams dang*/ rnal 'byor pa bdag gi zor lam du 'dug pa/ sgo ba/ 'phrang ba/ phyogs skyong ba thams cad la gser skyems phud kyi mchod pa 'bul lo// gzhan yang lan chags snying rje'i mgron 'gro ba rigs drug gi 'jig rten thams cad la gser skyems phud 'dis rang rang gi yid la 'dod pa'i dngos po thams cad 'byung bar gyur cig / tha ma nya'u brub khung du bcug nas/ e sus kyang mi thub spros bral dregs pa'i gnas// rnam par gru gsum dngos 'dzin gsong ba'i khang*// dngos med log rtog bcing ba'i btson ra che// srid gsum za byed me bsregs mun 'tshub par// nṛ tri/ ma rig gdug pa can gyi dgra bo 'di// 'jug shes lnga dang de yi rten nyams la// rnam shes thim kha gud pa'i lus can 'di// rang rig ye shes lcags su bcug par gyur// hūṃ bla ma drag po yi dam gsang sngags lha// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong ging tshogs kyi// bka' bden bden pa'i byin rlabs chen po des// bsgral 'os gnod byed dmigs pa 'dir khug cig /hūṃ bde gshegs 'dus pa khro bo'i spyi// rig 'jin bla ma drag po rtsal// sku gsung thugs ni mi bzad brgyan// gdug pa 'dul ba'i dus la bab// hūṃ zag med las kyi khro bo dang*// shes rab khro mo 'chol ba rnams// sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor mtha' yas pas// gdug pa 'dul ba'i dus la bab// hūṃ mgon po'i rnam pa'i gar gang la// srid dang srid min kun dmigs pa'i// sde brgyad dregs par bzhengs pa rnams// gdug pa 'dul ba'i dus la bab// hūṃ

dran pa'i pho nya lcags kyu ma yi tshogs// skar ltar 'khrug cing glog ltar 'khyug pa rnams// gnod byed phung khams skye mched 'jig rten gsum// gang na 'dug kyang lcags kyus aṅku sha dzaḥ// hūṃ shes bzhin pho nya zhags pa ser mo'i tshogs/ /skar ltar 'khrug cing glog ltar 'khyug pa rnams// gnod byed phung khams skye mched 'jig rten gsum// gang na 'dug kyang zhags pas pā sha hūṃ// hūṃ ma yengs pho nya lcags sgrog dmar mo'i tshogs// skar ltar 'khrug cing glog ltar 'khyug pa rnams// gnod byed phung khams skye mched 'jig rten gsum// gang na 'dug kyang sgrog gis spho ṭa baṃ// hūṃ rang grol pho nya dril bu ljang ma'i tshogs// skar ltar 'khrug cig glog ltar 'khyug pa rnams// gnod byed phung khams skye mched 'jig rten gsum// gar 'dug dril bus a be sha ya ho// hūṃ kun rmongs ma rungs dgra bo 'di// skyob pa'i las nyon lha nyon cig /sngon chad 'di yis 'jig rten rnams// mi bzad 'khor ba'i btson rar bcug /nyam thag sdug bsngal thams cad sbyar// dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phangs smad// bla ma'i gsung ngag khyad du bsad// bsgral 'os yin gyis ma skyob cig / yungs sogs thun/ hūṃ ye shes khro bo ging ka ra// thun rdzas gdug pa can gyi sde// byin gyis brlabs pa'i thun rdzas 'di// mi bzad mtshon cha'i 'khrul 'khor te// gnod byed lus ngag yid la ya// de nas phur skor byas ste/ hūṃ rgyal ba kun gyi nus pa'i gzugs// khro bo yaksha me dbal ni// lte ba man chad phur bu'i dbyibs// bsgril bas thams cad sdangs byed cing*// tshe dang bsod nams bdag gi gsos// rnam shes bsregs nas thar par 'dren// btab pas rdul du brlag par bya// de nas btab pa/ hūṃ dbang drag padma'i lha tshogs sku bzhengs la// rngam brjid rab tu 'jigs pa'i zhal gdongs shig /gru gsum bandha 'bar ba'i snod nang du// bar chad dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'di// dbang drag padma'i lha tshogs zhal du btab// dgyes par rol cig badzra a ra li// dbang drag padma khyed kyis bzhes nas kyang*// byang chub sgrub la bar chad med par mdzod// mahā maṃ sa la khā hi/

mahā rakta khā hi/ mahā tsitta khā hi/ mahā ba su ta khā hi/ mahā keṃ ni ri ti la khā hi/ dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūṃ dbang drag padma'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol// snyigs ma lnga ldan dus kyi mtha' ma 'dir// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor bying ba'i 'gro ba bdag /khyod la skyabs gsol yun gyi mgon bgyis na// thugs rje'i spyan gyis bdag la gzigs nas kyang*// khyod kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub thams cad kun// zhal zas tshogs mchod 'di la char ltar phob// dus 'di nyid du bdag la stsal du gsol// 'gyur ba med pa sku yi dngos grub stsol// 'gag pa med pa gsung gi dngos grub stsol// sgrib pa med pa thugs kyi dngos grub stsol// yon tan lhun gyis grub pa'i dngos grub stsol// 'phrin las thogs pa med pa'i dngos grub stsol// hūṃ snang ba mtha' yas 'od zer gyis// snod bcud sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// tshe dang bsod nams ye shes dpal// kun bsdus 'chi med tshe dang dpal// bya khyung klu 'dul 'jam dpal sku// rta mgrin gsung dang phyag rdor thugs// phag mo yon tan yakshas las// sdig pas dregs pa yongs 'dul ba'i// dbang dang dngos grub kun bstsal bas// sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam par gyur// kā ya siddhi oṃ/ wā ka siddhi āḥ tsitta siddhi hūṃ/ gu ṇa siddhi swā/ karma siddhi hā/ phud gsum gtor mar bcug /rnal 'byor rnams kyis longs spyod/ lhag ma dkyil 'khor gyi zur du bzhag la bdud rtsi sbran te/ cang te'u rdung*/ hūṃ dbang drag padma'i 'khor du gnas pa yi// phyi 'khor skyong ba'i srung ma thugs dam can// dbang phyug ging dang mkha' 'gro laṅka dang*// phra men shugs 'gro gshin rje gnod sbyin tshogs// 'jig pa'i lus la rngam pa'i cha byad can// legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod ma// rdzu 'phrul thogs med dpal gyi pham lhag sdud// ting 'dzin drod myul rnal 'byor tshogs khang nyul// rang rang sprul pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// zhal zas tshogs kyi lhag ma 'di bzhes la// ji ltar dbang ba'i 'phrin las so sor mdzod// oṃ utstshi ṣṭa sarba ḍā ki nī ba lingta khā hi//

de nas chad rdo sgrag pa/ hūṃ bde bar gshegs pa kun gyi dbyings// snang ba mtha' yas spyan ras gzigs// padma 'byung gnas sprul pa'i sku// rim pa bzhin du mngon par bzhengs// de'i tshe gdug pa can thams cad// 'dul ba'i dus la bab gzigs nas// shin tu khros pa'i dkyil 'khor bstan// mthong ba'i mod la de dag brgyal// slar yang thugs rjes bslad nas su// bstan pa srung ba'i chad sdo byas// bka' sdod pho nyar rtsis la phab// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i las sgrub pa'i// pho nyar mngags pas bdag sbran no// dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab// skul ba ni/ kwa ye rig 'dzin padma khyod// 'gro ba kun la rtag tu gzigs// 'phrin las mdzad pa'i dus mi yol// khro rgyal tshogs pa khyod kyi mthu// do nub dgra dang bgegs la ston// nyams pa de dag tshar chod cig /kwaye khro bo khro mo'i tshogs// zhing skyong dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs// dpal mgon lcam dral nag po'i tshogs// las mdzad dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs// hūṃ gi sgra sgrog di ri ri// phaṭ kyi sgra sgrog khra la la// gang la bya ba khyed kyis mkhyen// yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs 'di// dbang du sdud la rdul du rlog /thams cad bdag gir ma dar sbron// bos so rdo rje'i snyan ma sra// g.yabs so ye shes spyan ma rtul// gdungs so snying rje ma g.yel bar// dmag dpung chen po da chos shig /mi shig go cha da bgos shig /dgra bo mthar byed g.yul gshogs shig /phas rgol thams cad rlag byos shig /'di ni bsgral ba'i 'os yin no// bden pa thams cad khyad gsod do// dkon mchog gsum la des sdo'o// chos skyong gnyan por brnyas gyur te// sems can kun la 'tshe byed do// rje btsun bla ma'i thugs dkrugs so// las 'bras dag la mi rtsi'o// nag po'i sdig la ham lags so// dkar po'i chos la gnag lags so// nyon mongs dug gis brgyal lags so// ngan 'gro'i phyogs su gzhol lags so// 'di 'drar mthu stobs mi ston na// gzhan gyis mi thub nus pa rdzun// 'gro don dus las g.yel bas na// dam bca' mdzad pa'i dus las 'das// rnal 'byor dbang phyug yi chad 'gyur// de bas myur du tshar chod cig

/ ces pas bskul/ hūṃ rig 'dzin drag po'i nus mthu dang*// bka' nyan bden pa'i stobs chen gyis// phas kyi byad ma mkhan rnams kyis// ting nge 'dzin dang rig sngags dang*// rdzas kyi sbyor ba ngan rtsom pa/ thams cad byad ma nyid la zlog /steng gdon lha dang 'og gdon klu// bar gdon bgegs kyi bar chad kun// sdang bar byed pa'i dgra la zlog /'phral rkyen ran pa byur dang ni// bdud dang 'gong po'i g.yo thabs kun// gnod byed sdang ba'i dgra la sgyur// lha srin za kha de la gtor// de nas/ hūṃ nga ni gtor zor gnyen po 'phen// phyogs skyong yul lha la sogs pa// gdong dus su yang ma sdod cig /sdang ba'i dgra bo gar 'dug par// dmar gtor chen po 'di 'phang ngo*// thun rdzas mtshon cha kun 'phang ngo*// phyi yi yul 'khor rlag pa dang*// nang gi mi brgyud rtsad nas chod// rbad pa'i dus su mthu ma chung*// mngags pa'i don chen brjed mi 'os// bcol ba'i dus su brtson pa dang*// bsgo ba'i don chen sgrub par mdzod// ces gtor ma 'phang ngo*// de nas gtor snod kha sbub/ der bgegs thams cad mnan par bsam mo// hūṃ thams cad chos dbyings yangs pa'i klong*// ci shar ci snang mnyam pa nyid// bar chad bgegs kyi ming yang med// rig 'dzin bla ma'i rol pa'o// g.yas brkyang dpa' bo rol pa'i 'chams// stong nyid dbyings su chems se chems// g.yon brkyang dpa' mo rol pa'i gar// snying rje'i ngang du khrigs se khrigs// zlum po mnyam nyid zung 'jug bro// kha sbyor chen por shigs se shigs// de nas bstan skyong*/ bshal chu yig 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la 'di skad do// hūṃ srog la dbang sgyur bdud mo bzhi// nor la dbang sgyur gnod sbyin bzhi// rdzu 'phrul dbang sgyur sman mo bzhi// dre'u rta mang po chibs la byon// bran g.yog mang po'i 'khor bcas rnams// lhab lhab za 'go dar gos gyon// sil sil rin chen rgyan gyis spung*// 'dir byon dam tshig skong lags so// bstan ma bcu gnyis khyed rnams kyis// slob dpon padma 'byung gnas la// ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin// bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod//

ces bshal chu gtor ro// de nas yig brgya 'don/ bsngo ba dang bkra shis bya'o// zhes pa 'di sdags 'chang chos rgyal phun tshogs kyis ring mo nas bskul ba ltar dang*/ sger du blo bzang dga' bos che dag nyer gyis kyang bskul ba ltar/ slob dpon nyid las gnang ba thob pa padma dkar pos/ lho brag mkhar chu zhes bya ba mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i sgrub gnas chen po'i mgul/ nyams dga' sman gyi gshod yar rtse spang gi cog sgar du spre'u lo sprel zla'i tshes bcu la sbyar ba'o// //

༄༅/ /gu ru drag po'i dbang mo che rdo rje'i spyi blugs bzhugs so: ma drag po'i lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: rdo rje drag po rtsal gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi dbang bskur ba'i rim pa ni: sngon 'gro sta gon:dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba dang : rjes mtha' bskyang bar bya'o: dang po ni: gnas yid dang mthun par gtor ma dpe chung ltar bshams laḥ dkyil 'khor bri: sa rgyan gnam rgyan bkram: tsakka li rnams lha gdan la gzugs: sman rag mchod pa dang bcas pa 'dzom pa dang : slob bu rnams khrus byas: rgyan btags la gral la 'dug: las rim ltar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed: bskyed rim gyi bar du 'jug: bar der sgrub thabs ltar bskyed rim phog la bsnyen pa bya: de nas spyan drangs la tshogs yar cad tshar ba dang :sngon la drang don du blo kha bsgyur la byin dbab: nyul le bskrad pa sogs bya'o: gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni: slob dpon gyis las bum thogs la khrus bya'o: srung skud gdags: de nas me tog: maṇḍal phul la slob ma rnams kyis gsol ba gdab: e ma bla ma rin po che: bdag cag 'khor ba'i btson rar chud: thugs rje'i lcags kyus gzung du gsol: bdag cag gzung 'dzin zhags pas bsdams: shes rab ral gris gcad du gsol: bla ma drag po thod 'phreng gi: dbang mchog dam pa stsal du gsol: zhes pa dang*/ bla mas yol ba'i nang nas 'di skad da ོ: ho: bu khyod su yin ci zhig bya: gsang sngags zab mo'i dkyil 'khor 'diraḥ 'jug pa'i skal ldan las 'phro canaḥ brgya lam na ni re 'ga' tsam: rtsa gsum dam tshig srung nus sam: zhes brjod:slob bus: ho:bdag ni rig pa'i bu gcig pu: sngon sbyangs las 'phro can yin no: rtsa gsum dam tshig bdag gis srung : thugs rjes dgongs la dbang bskur zhu: zhes pas dkyil 'khor bla ma dang bcas pa la skor ba lan gsum bskor: phyogs bzhi nas phyag 'tshal: slob bus me tog gtor: mig dar bkab: hūṃ: gu ru drag po'i dkyil 'khor duḥ

rang rig snang ba'i me tog 'bul: sngon sbyangs las 'phro gang yod pa'iḥ yi dam lha dang da sprod cigaḥ ces pas me tog gtoraḥ gang bab lha las 'dres pa'i gsang mtshan gdags: mig dar bshus: rdo rjes mig phyis: ho: ji ltar mig mkhan mig phye ltar: khyod kyi ma rig ling tog 'di: rig pa'i ngang du da phye bas: bla ma drag po'i lha la ltos: zhes lha ngo sprad do: de nas cod pan mdo la bzhag: hoḥ deng nas bu khyod rgyal ba'i sras: bla ma drag po'i thugs srog 'dzin: dbang rtags cod pan pu ru ru: 'khor 'das rang grol dbang thob shog: na mo pu ru sha a bhiṣiñtsa hūṃḥ de nas thog mar bum pa mgo la bzhag: bum chu ngag tu blud: rol mo sbir laḥ hūṃ: bum pa kun bzang gzhal yas khang gi nang : bum rdzas rang gsal dag po thod 'phreng rtsal: dbang bzhi thob nas dri bzhi dag pa'i don: skal ldan bu mchog khyod kyis thob par shog: oṃ āḥhūṃ a rtsig nir tsig na mo bha ga wa te hūṃ hūṃ a hūṃ hūṃ phaṭḥphaṭ abhi ṣiñtsa oṃ āḥhūṃ hrīḥhā: thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba mgo la gtugs la: ngag tu blud: ho: dus gsum don mdzad padma 'byung gnas sku: dad mos can la spyi gtsug mngon sum 'byung : padma ltar gsal dri med sprul pa'i sku: skal ldan bu mchog khyod kyis dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra gu ru ha ri ni sa siddhi hūṃ:a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ āḥhūṃ hrīḥhāḥ rdo rje dril bu mgo la bzhag: ho: rang lus phung po lha dang lha mo'i ngang : thod 'phreng rtsal mchog longs spyod rigs lnga'i sku: dug snga dag nas ye shes lngar gsal ba: skal ldan bu mchog khyod kyis dbang thob shog: oṃ ā:hūṃ gu ru drag po rtsal a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ ā hūṃ hrīḥhā: bu ti 'jam dpal sku bcas dpral bar bzhag: ho: bde gshegs sku dngos 'jam dpal gtso bo ste: rmongs pa'i blo sel dug lnga'i bdud las grol: chos sgo kun la sgo mdzod rang dbye ba'i:

skal ldan bu mchog khyod kyis thob par shog: oṃ muṃ:wā gi shwa ri a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ ā:hūṃ hrīḥhā: mgrin par phur ba sku bcas bzhag: ho: bde gshegs gsung dngos rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal: rgyal 'gong dregs pa sde brgyad zil gyis gnon: 'phrin las gang la thogs pa med pa'i dbang : skal ldan bu mchog khyod kyis thob par shog: hrī:badzra kro dha gṝ wa hūṃ hūṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ āḥhūṃ hrīḥhā: snying gar rdo rje sku bcas bzhag: hoḥ bde gshegs thugs dngos phyag na rdo rje'i mthus: klu dang sa bdag gza' rnams zil gyis gnon: nus rtsal gang la thog dang 'dra ba'i dbang : skal ldan bu mchog khyod kyis dbang thob shog: badzra tsaṇḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ: gsang gnas su me dbal sku bcas las bum bzhag cing bkru: ho: bde gshegs 'phrin las yaksha me dbal sku: gdon bgegs gnod sbyin ma lus rdul du rlog: snang srid dbang sdud dregs pa tshar gcod dbang : skal ldan bu mchog khyod kyis dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra yaksha hūṃ a bh-iṣiñtsa oṃ āḥhūṃ hrīḥhā gnas lngar khyung lnga bzhag la: ho: bde gshegs yon tan bya khyung ka ru ṇa: mkha' lding rgyal po drag po thod 'phreng bran: sna tshogs 'phrin las re ba skong ba'i dbangaḥ skal ldan bu mchog khyod kyis thob par shogaḥ khro gha ru ṇa:badzra ka ru ṇa:ratna ka ru ṇa:padma ka ru ṇa:karma ka ru ṇa:tsa le tsa le a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ ā:hūṃ hrīḥhā: de nas tshe zan mgo la bzhag: ho: tshe dpag med pa bde gshegs gsung : 'chi med lcags srog rdo rje 'dra: mi shigs ā yu dbang mchog de: skal ldan bu yis thob par shog: oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe bruṃ hrī:a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ ā:hūṃ hrī:hā: de nas bgrang 'phreng sku bcas lag tu gtad: ho: bskyed rims gsal bas dran 'dzin zhig: sngags bzlas chu bo'i gzhung dang mtshungs: gsal stong grag stong lha sngags dbang :

skal ldan bu yis thob par shog: oṃ ā:hūṃ ar tsig nir na mo bha ga wa te hūṃ hūṃ a hūṃ hūṃ phaṭḥphaṭ:ya manta ka:hya gṝ wa:badzra pā ṇi:ḍā ki nī:ka ru ṇa hūṃ phaṭ:a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭ: oṃ badzra yaksha hūṃ phaṭ:gnod byed sarba mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭ:: ces rtsa sngags brjod: thod ḍaṃ thod khrag lag tu gtad: ho: snang ba dbang sdud ḍa ma ru: dngos grub 'byung ba'i thod khrag ni: mkha' 'gro dpa' bo'i srog gi rten: dbang mchog dam pa thob par shog: ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī:ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ ā:hūṃ hrī:hā: de nas gtor ma spyi gtsug tu bzhag: brgyud pa'i bla ma gsol ba btab la: rol mo sbir: hūṃ: 'gro ba 'dren mdzad drag po thod 'phreng sku: u rgyan yul byon 'gro kun lam sna drangs: rgya gar yul byon thos bsam sgron me spar: bod kyi yul byon gdug pa ma lus btul: sku tshab lung stan gsung tshab gter du sbas: thugs kyi dgongs pa dad can kun la 'bebs: smin grol dbang dang gdams pa ma lus kun: skal ldan bu mchog 'di la stsal du gsol: 'chi med tshe yi dbang mchog stsal du gsol: 'ga' med gsung gi dbang mchog stsal du gsol: mi brjed thugs kyi dbang mchog stsal du gsol: dam pa chos kyi dbang mchog stsal du gsol: dgos 'byung nor bu'i dbang mchog stsal du gsol: oṃ ā:hūṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī ba lingta a bhiṣiñtsa oṃ ā:hūṃ hrī: de ltar rdzas de rnams spyi bor byung : bum dbang thob: lus sgrib dag: sku'i dbang thob: lus lha sgom pa la dbang : 'bras bu sprul sku thob: mgrin par byung : gsang dbang thob: ngag sgrib dag: bde gshegs gsung gi dbang thob: snying po bzlas pa la dbang : 'bras bu longs sku thob: snying gar byung : yid sgrib dag: shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob: bde gshegs thugs kyi dbang thob: rdzogs rim sgom pa la dbang :

'bras bu chos sku thob: de ma bcos par dar re zhog: ces brjod: bkra shis brjod: me tog gtor: dga' ston rgya chen po bya: rjes kyi las la 'jug par bya'o: e ma hoḥ rdo rje thod 'phreng drag sgrub kyi: phyi nang gsang gsum dril ba yi: dbang chog kun las 'di khyad 'phags: dbang 'di ma thob sgrub byed pa: khang stong rkun mo 'khyam pa 'dra: dbang 'di thob pa'i skyes bu ni: tshe 'dir bsam pa kun grub ste: 'das tshe gdung dang ring bsrel dang : 'ja' 'od sa g.yos smos ci dgos: 'di yis lan cig 'brel ba yang : mtshams med lnga byas sdig byang bas: las can gcig dang 'phrad par shog: sā mya yya: rgya rgya rgya: mnga' bdag myang gi spyan drangs nas: thugs dam rim pa sras la gnang : gcig las gnyis su spel ba na: ḍā ki ma yi bka' 'chad 'byung : rgya rgya rgya: de nas bkra shis ni: hūṃ: pho brang gzhal yas mkha' spyod nas: rig 'dzin bdag la byin gyis rlobs: nad med tshe ring bsod nams dar: lha srin dam la thogs pa'i bkra shis shogaḥ dngos grub can gyi bla ma la: dad gus ltem rkyang med pa dang : byin rlabs sku gsum thob nas su: dus min bar chad zhi ba dang : longs spyod 'byor ldan bkra shis shog: sngon tshe bsags rgyab bla ma mnyes: nyin mtshan rtag par bkra shis nas: 'bral med chos la spyod pa yis: 'di phyi gnyis kar bkra shis shog: bla ma sku tshe ring ba dang : yi dam dngos grub thob pa dang : mkha' 'gros bar chad sel ba dang : 'gro don phyogs med bkra shis shog: 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ padma 'byung gnas/ ye shes mtsho rgyal/ myang nyi ma 'od zer ram ral pa can/ sras 'gro mgon chos seng*/ grub thob me long rdo rje/ sras ha ri rdo rje/ bla ma bson nams 'od zer/ chos rje nam mkha' rdo rje/ rje chos kyi grags pa/ yon tan ye shes/ padma dkar po/ bstan pa'i nyi ma/ des bdag ngag dbang rnam rgyal la'o// bar pa/ padma 'byung gnas kyis chos kyi grags pa dang*/
